project_guidance.title: Welsh roof-light checks
project_guidance.intro: Use this starting point with the full official guidance and the planning history for your address.
rules: Roof alterations and roof lights have separate requirements from solar panels.
Check the 150mm projection limit, ridge height, matching materials and side-window privacy.
The householder allowance does not cover roof lights on designated land or the creation of a roof terrace.
